data.name: Kart Racing Strike
data.detailed_description:
Just Updated

Get ready for a bigger racing experience! This update brings new karts, exciting new tracks, and improved AI opponents that are smarter, faster, and more challenging than ever before.

Compete against tougher rivals in the Championship mode, test your skills on fresh circuits, and discover new ways to race your way to victory. Every race is now more competitive, strategic, and thrilling!

More speed. More challenges. More championship moments await!


About the Game

Choose your machine, learn each circuit, battle competitive rivals, and fight your way to the front of the grid.

Race across a variety of tracks with different layouts, corners, elevation changes, and environments. From floating sky circuits to technical courses where a single mistake can cost you the lead, every race is designed to keep the action moving.

⚡ Fast Arcade Racing

Kart Racing Strike focuses on responsive and accessible racing.

Accelerate hard, control your racing line, use your boost at the right moment, and look for opportunities to overtake your rivals.

The AI racers stay competitive throughout the race, so winning requires more than simply holding the accelerator. Good cornering, consistent driving, and smart boost usage can make the difference between P1 and falling behind.

🏆 Championship Mode

Enter the Championship and compete across multiple races against a field of rival drivers.

Your finishing position determines the points you earn after every round. Stay consistent, collect as many points as possible, climb the standings, and prove that you are the best racer on the grid.

⏱️ Time Attack

Want to race without opponents?

Take on Time Attack and focus entirely on improving your own performance. Learn the fastest route through every circuit, improve your corner exits, perfect your racing line, and keep chasing a better time.

Every second matters.

🚘 Build Your Car Collection

Visit the Garage / Machine Lab to explore your collection of racing machines.

Every vehicle has its own performance characteristics, including:

  • Top Speed

  • Acceleration

  • Handling

  • Drift Control

  • Overall Performance Rating

Unlock new machines, experiment with different vehicles, and find the car that best matches your driving style.

Some special vehicles can also be earned through objectives and rewards.

☁️ Dynamic Racing Environments

Race through distinctive environments featuring floating islands, clouds, elevated tracks, and different circuit atmospheres.

Each track has its own visual identity while keeping the focus on fast and competitive racing.

🚧 Interactive Track Objects

Not everything on the circuit stays perfectly still.

Lightweight track objects such as traffic cones can react when struck by vehicles. Hit them at speed and watch them scatter and tumble across the circuit, adding a little extra chaos to close racing.

🎮 Features

  • Fast-paced arcade racing

  • Competitive AI opponents

  • Championship mode with points and standings

  • Time Attack mode

  • Multiple racing circuits

  • Vehicle collection

  • Garage / Machine Lab

  • Different vehicle performance ratings

  • Nitro boost system

  • Real-time race position tracking

  • Physical track objects

  • Floating cloud and sky-island environments

  • Fullscreen racing experience

  • Keyboard controls

  • Quick races and longer championship sessions

🏎️ Take the Grid

Choose your machine, line up against your rivals, and hit the throttle.

Whether you're fighting for championship points or trying to shave another second off your best Time Attack run, Kart Racing Strike is all about getting back on the track and going faster.

Start your engine. Hit the boost. Take the win.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 2.0 GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Graphics (Intel HD Graphics 4000 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: Keyboard required. Game is optimized for 60 FPS at 1280×720 resolution.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 / AMD Radeon R7 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: Game runs best at 60 FPS with smooth particle effects enabled.
